parameters.content:
## Vendor Onboarding — SLA Escalation

Scheduled workflow (default 09:00 UTC daily). Finds cases in REVIEW_REQUIRED or APPROVAL_PENDING beyond their SLA thresholds and escalates them via the exception triage endpoint.

**This workflow does not define SLA thresholds.** It reads them from settings. The backend owns the thresholds because the frontend displays them and the backend enforces them.
